title: CBDT Extends Tax Audit and ITR Due Dates for AY 2026-27!
content:
# CBDT Extends Tax Audit and ITR Due Dates for AY 2026-27!

Ek important update hai! Government ne Assessment Year (AY) 2026-27 ke liye Tax Audit Report aur Income Tax Return (ITR) filing ki due dates extend kar di hain. This will bring relief to many taxpayers and professionals.

Here’s a quick summary of the changes:

*   **Old Due Date for Tax Audit Report:** September 30, 2026
*   **New Due Date for Tax Audit Report:** October 21, 2026
*   **Old Due Date for ITR (for audit cases):** October 31, 2026
*   **New Due Date for ITR (for audit cases):** November 21, 2026

This extension applies to persons whose accounts are required to be audited under the Income-tax Act, 1961, as specified in Explanation 2 to sub-section (1) of Section 139. The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) announced this via Circular No. 07/2026 dated September 28, 2026.
